SELECT TOP 200
  g.Path AS Host,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) = g.Path
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine')) AS "Virtual machines",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) = g.Path AND v.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine')) AS "VMs not healthy",
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.ServerRole')
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, g.Path

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.ServerRole')) AS Hosts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.ServerRole') AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "Hosts not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine')) AS "Virtual machines",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine') AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "VMs not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
     AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})) AS "Open Hyper-V alerts"

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.ServerRole')) AS Hosts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.ServerRole') AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "Hosts not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine')) AS "Virtual machines",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine') AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)) AS "VMs not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
     AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})) AS "Open Hyper-V alerts"

SELECT TOP 1000
  g.DisplayName AS VM,
  LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine')
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, 2, 1

SELECT TOP 1000
  h.DisplayName AS Host,
  vm.DisplayName AS VM,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.vRelationship r2 JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity c ON c.ManagedEntityRowId = r2.TargetManagedEntityRowId
     JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType ct ON ct.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = c.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
     WHERE r2.SourceManagedEntityRowId = vm.ManagedEntityRowId AND ct.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualDrive') AS "Virtual drives",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.vRelationship r2 JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity c ON c.ManagedEntityRowId = r2.TargetManagedEntityRowId
     JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType ct ON ct.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = c.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
     WHERE r2.SourceManagedEntityRowId = vm.ManagedEntityRowId AND ct.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualNetworkAdapter') AS "Network adapters"
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity vm
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType vt ON vt.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = vm.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND vt.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine'
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = vm.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
ORDER BY h.DisplayName, vm.DisplayName

SELECT DISTINCT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Warning' END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  LEFT(COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1)
  AND e.IsDeleted = 0 AND e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
  AND LEFT(COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC

SELECT TOP 300
  CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
  AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC

WITH x AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS host, vm.DisplayName AS vmname, r.ObjectName AS o, r.CounterName AS c, i.InstanceName AS inst, p.SampleValue AS v, p.DateTime AS t,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ManagedEntityRowId, r.RuleRowId, i.InstanceName ORDER BY p.DateTime DESC) AS rn
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  LEFT JOIN dbo.vRelationship rel ON rel.TargetManagedEntityRowId = e.ManagedEntityRowId
       AND rel.RelationshipTypeRowId IN (SELECT RelationshipTypeRowId FROM dbo.vRelationshipType WHERE RelationshipTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine.Hosts.%')
  LEFT JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity vm ON vm.ManagedEntityRowId = rel.SourceManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
    AND p.DateTime > DATEADD(hour, -24, GETUTCDATE())
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
)
SELECT TOP 500 host AS Host, COALESCE(vmname, '(host)') AS VM, o AS Object, c AS Counter, inst AS Instance, v AS Value, t AS "Sampled (UTC)"
FROM x WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY host, vmname, o, c

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         COALESCE(vm.DisplayName, h.DisplayName) + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  LEFT JOIN dbo.vRelationship rel ON rel.TargetManagedEntityRowId = e.ManagedEntityRowId
       AND rel.RelationshipTypeRowId IN (SELECT RelationshipTypeRowId FROM dbo.vRelationshipType WHERE RelationshipTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine.Hosts.%')
  LEFT JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity vm ON vm.ManagedEntityRowId = rel.SourceManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
    AND r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName = '${hvcounter}'
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), COALESCE(vm.DisplayName, h.DisplayName), i.InstanceName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         COALESCE(vm.DisplayName, h.DisplayName) + CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN '' ELSE ' [' + i.InstanceName + ']' END,
         AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  LEFT JOIN dbo.vRelationship rel ON rel.TargetManagedEntityRowId = e.ManagedEntityRowId
       AND rel.RelationshipTypeRowId IN (SELECT RelationshipTypeRowId FROM dbo.vRelationshipType WHERE RelationshipTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.VirtualMachine.Hosts.%')
  LEFT JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity vm ON vm.ManagedEntityRowId = rel.SourceManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
    AND r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName = '${hvcounter}'
    AND h.DisplayName IN (${hvhost:singlequote})
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, COALESCE(vm.DisplayName, h.DisplayName), i.InstanceName
) x ORDER BY time

list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the OperationsManager database. Chosen automatically if its name contains "Operational", "Operations" or "SCOM" (and not "Warehouse"/"DW"); otherwise pick it here.

list.name: hvhost
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName AS __text, h.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.ServerRole'
ORDER BY 1
list.label: Hyper-V host
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName AS __text, h.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.ServerRole'
ORDER BY 1

list.name: hvcounter
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT r.ObjectName + ' | ' + r.CounterName AS __text, r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName AS __value
FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
ORDER BY 1
list.label: Counter
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT r.ObjectName + ' | ' + r.CounterName AS __text, r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName AS __value
FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.HyperV.%'
ORDER BY 1
